We turn messy data into context for AI

Empowering enterprises to deploy AI with confidence

Our mission

Led by a team of visionary experts, with decades of combined experience in the unstructured data space, we’ve made it our mission to enable organizations to turn informal organizational information – locked inside millions of emails, messages, PDFs, notes, calls, customer reviews and more – into a unified layer of organizational truth that fuels human, AI and agentic decision making. This is how our technology delivers context for AI.
